01 / CAPABILITIES

Every angle.
One accountable team.

Six connected capabilities.
One considered approach to your site.

SVC / GUARDING

Manned Guarding

Static posts, gatehouse control and reception security with documented shift handovers. SIA licensing and BS 7858 vetting are concept standards, not verified claims.

SVC / PATROLS

Mobile Patrols

Randomised schedules and logged checkpoints, designed to make out-of-hours activity visible. Reporting and tracking are not connected in this preview.

SVC / RESPONSE

Alarm Response

A proposed keyholding and response workflow: attend, assess, secure and report. This demonstration cannot receive or respond to alarms.

SVC / MONITORING

CCTV Monitoring

Remote observation and audio challenge are part of the service concept. All screen imagery on this page is original artwork, not surveillance footage.

SVC / ACCESS

Access Control

Card, fob and visitor management concepts with audit trails. No access codes, biometrics, credentials or site plans are requested by this page.

SVC / EVENTS

Event Security

Crowd management, stewarding and a documented safety plan, designed around the event. Actual capacity and compliance need a verified provider.
